data.name: The Floral Princes
data.detailed_description:
Enter the dying kingdom of Floralia, where cursed Floral Princes fight against the corruption consuming their world.

Forge romantic bonds, uncover hidden truths, and shape your destiny through fantasy battles, emotional choices, and unforgettable encounters.

🌸 A dark fantasy otome adventure

⚔️ Turn-based fantasy battles with unique Floral Princes

💖 Romantic routes shaped by your choices

🃏 Collect cards, unlock memories, and discover hidden lore

🌿 Restore the royal garden and uncover Floralia’s secrets

✨ Cinematic visual novel presentation with animated UI

🎭 Choose your protagonist identity and experience the story your way

In a kingdom where flowers once carried sacred power, corruption now spreads across the land. The Floral Princes stand as the final guardians of a fading world.

Will your heart become their salvation… or witness the fall of Floralia?

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics compatible with OpenGL 2.0
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
